「こ―――――――――」

SHIKI leaps not at Akiha but at Kohaku beside her.

Whether she understood how I felt or not, Akiha never spoke of that night.
And so long as the head of the Tohno family chose to feign ignorance, I believed I could continue living as Shiki Tohno for a while longer.
